pr_title: [CI] Integrate mooncake to vllm-ascend base image

correspondence.patch_snippet: 评后sha `fac99b1` make -j$(nproc) 体现修改

antipattern.code:
FROM quay.io/ascend/cann:8.3.rc1-ubuntu22.04-py3.11

ARG MOONCAKE_TAG="v0.5.0"
ENV VLLM_WORKSPACE=/workspace

WORKDIR $VLLM_WORKSPACE


RUN mkdir -p build && cd build && \
    cmake .. -DUSE_ASCEND_DIRECT=ON && \
    make -j2 && make install

pattern.code:
FROM quay.io/ascend/cann:8.3.rc1-ubuntu22.04-py3.11

ARG MOONCAKE_TAG="v0.5.0"
ENV VLLM_WORKSPACE=/workspace

WORKDIR $VLLM_WORKSPACE


RUN mkdir -p build && cd build && \
    cmake .. -DUSE_ASCEND_DIRECT=ON && \
    make -j$(nproc) && make install
